import html # Predefined template for rendering the profile on a web page. # Placeholders: {fullname}, {biography}, {current_status} PROFILE_FORMAT = """

{fullname}

{biography}

Status: {current_status}
""" def display_user_profile(fullname: str, biography: str, current_status: str) -> str: """ Render a user profile for web display. Parameters ---------- fullname : str The user's name as entered. biography : str A potentially multi‑sentence user biography. current_status : str The user's brief, current status message. Returns ------- str A sanitized HTML snippet containing the profile information. Raises ------ ValueError If any argument is not a string or is empty after stripping. """ # Basic validation for name, value in (("fullname", fullname), ("biography", biography), ("current_status", current_status)): if not isinstance(value, str): raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a string") if not value.strip(): raise ValueError(f"{name} cannot be empty") # Escape user input to prevent XSS (CWE‑79) escaped_fullname = html.escape(fullname, quote=True) escaped_biography = html.escape(biography, quote=True) escaped_status = html.escape(current_status, quote=True) # Format the profile using the predefined template return PROFILE_FORMAT.format( fullname=escaped_fullname, biography=escaped_biography, current_status=escaped_status )
